claims.value: Psalm 23:1 describes YHWH as the speaker’s shepherd. Preserve the shepherd image rather than replacing it entirely with abstract care.
claims.reviewer_notes: Machine proposal; requires qualified human review. Does not assert that every image in the Psalm is a single kingship metaphor.

principles.value: Evaluate whether a draft preserves parallel line relationships and metaphorical imagery, and record losses separately from the translation.

evidence.note: Paraphrased evaluation guidance; extracted text is not included.

principles.reviewer_notes: Machine proposal based on supplied PDF; no human approval recorded.
diagnostic_indicators: Compare corresponding source and target lines
Identify metaphors flattened into abstract explanation
constraints: Do not force a parallelism classification when evidence is uncertain

brief.philosophy: preserve meaning, theological constraints, imagery and defensible poetic relationships

limitations: Consonantal alignment is heuristic and awaits human review.
No melody supplied; no claim of full singability.
No automatically inferred poetic or theological interpretation is treated as fact.
